title: Slice Defense Recovery (Michelle Grogan)
style: fast phonk progressive trance heavy bongo bass guitar 136bpm pickleball training high energy English Spanish coach calls no slow sections
lyrics:
[Intro]
Ball comes fast off their paddle, no time
Slice it back low, recover the line

[Verse 1]
Fast ball arriving at mid height or low
Open paddle face, slice under to go
Cut across the back of the ball at contact
Low skidding return, keep the rally intact

Elbow out, paddle high to low through
Slice defense brings the ball back true
Open face angle, ten degrees back
Slice defense recovery, stay on track

[Pre-Chorus]
Paddle high to low, face open wide
Cut across the ball, send it back inside
Elbow out, slice through and hold
Slice defense recovery, composed and bold

[Chorus]
Slice defense recovery, high to low
Open face angled, cut and go
Elbow out, paddle cuts through
Slice defense recovery sees you through

[Verse 2]
After the slice, two steps forward to the kitchen
Slice is your reset, not the position
Slice sets up the next ball at the line
Slice defense to kitchen, that is the design

[Bridge]
Bluey: Incredible slice defense there, ball comes back low and skidding
Trevor: The high to low swing path with open face creates maximum backspin on the return
Michelle: Slice to reset. Then move forward. The slice is never the last shot.

[Chorus]
Slice defense recovery, high to low
Open face angled, cut and go
Elbow out, paddle cuts through
Slice defense recovery sees you through

[Outro]
Slice to reset
Then move forward
Slice defense recovery
